name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in his late teens, captivated by the roar of engines at the Estoril circuit. He initially worked as a mechanic, quickly demonstrating an aptitude for problem-solving and a keen understanding of vehicle dynamics. His career progressed through various racing teams, each role honing his management skills and technical expertise. He joined GCK Motorsport a decade ago as a senior engineer, rising through the ranks to become team principal.

Ricardo is known for his analytical approach and ability to foster a collaborative environment. He believes in empowering his team members and encouraging innovation, while maintaining a focus on data-driven decision-making. He is a staunch believer in sustainability within motorsport, championing the development and implementation of eco-friendly technologies within the team's operations. Ricardo distinguishes himself by his unwavering commitment to nurturing young talent, providing opportunities for aspiring engineers and drivers to develop and excel.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a focused and thoughtful demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out copy of 'The Art of War'.
Insists on hand-drawing schematics before using CAD software.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
